dt4.py.summary: Translate a text file in chunks while saving the progress.
details: Splits the input into 2500-character chunks, translates them with the chosen backend (deep_translator, DeepL, translate, Bing, googletrans, pygoogletranslation), saves ``chunks.json`` every ten chunks, keeps a ``failed.txt`` list and ``--no-continue`` starts from scratch.

dt5.py.summary: Translate a text file in chunks with resume support and detailed logging.
details: Smart-chunks the text, runs the workers against the first usable backend in the fallback order, retries with backoff, saves the state atomically, handles an interruption gracefully and logs to ``<output>.debug.log``; ``--list-backends`` prints what is available.
dt5.py.usage: dt5 INPUT [-o OUT.json] [-s LANG] [-t LANG] [--backends LIST]

dtg.py.summary: Translate the comments, docstrings and print statements of Python files in place.
details: Collects the translatable strings with tokenize/ast, batches them through ``deep_translator`` (or another backend), applies the replacements, keeps a ``.translation_state.json`` for the resume and works through the files concurrently.

dtluna.py.summary: Translate a text file in independently resumable chunks.
details: Supports deep_translator, DeepL, translate, Bing, googletrans, pygoogletranslation, boto3, Azure, Baidu, Alibaba and Watson, maps the language codes per backend, throttles the requests, saves the results atomically and logs the run.

dufpy.py.summary: Find the Python files with identical normalized ASTs.
details: Normalizes each file (comments, formatting and names of the local definitions), hashes the result with xxhash, groups the matches and caches them in ``.cache.json``; ``-r`` keeps the first file of each group and deletes the others, ``--rich`` adds a progress bar.

dup_detector.py.summary: Detect and refactor the duplicate Python objects of a tree.
details: Hashes the top-level definitions, writes the exact duplicate JSON report, with ``-r`` moves the ones appearing more than five times into ``utils.py`` and updates the imports, and ``-f`` adds a fuzzy report (ssdeep + rapidfuzz) of the objects above 50 % similarity.

dupdirs.py.summary: Find the duplicate folders of the current directory tree.
details: Hashes every folder by the content of its files and reports the groups that are identical; ``-s`` reports the folders that only share the same structure (same names, different contents).

dupeguru.py.summary: Find the duplicate files and optionally delete them.
details: Sizes the files, then hashes a 64 KB prefix and the full content in a pool, groups the identical ones and reports the space that could be freed; ``-a`` deletes the duplicates (dry run by default), ``-m`` sets the minimum size.

dupeguru_textual.py.summary: Duplicate-file finder with a Textual terminal interface.
details: Hashes the files of a directory, groups the duplicates by hash with a filename-fuzzy score and shows them in a Textual results table with the scan progress, letting you inspect the candidates before acting.

dupfuncanalyzer.py.summary: Detect the repeated functions of a project and refactor them into a shared module.
details: Normalizes the definitions with ast, groups the ones that appear more than once, writes them to ``repeated_functions.py`` (imported as ``dh``) and with ``-a`` removes the duplicates and adds the imports.

dupfx.py.summary: Find and delete the duplicate files by content.
details: Pre-filters by size and a 4 KB head hash, confirms with a full xxhash and chooses which copy to keep (``-k``: first, last, oldest, newest, largest); ``-r`` deletes, ``-n`` previews, ``--all`` includes ``.git``.

duptools.py.summary: Report, delete or symlink the duplicate files of a directory.
details: Subcommands: ``report`` lists the groups, ``delete`` keeps one copy and removes the rest, ``symlink`` moves the master copies to a stash and links the others, and ``restore`` reverses that from the manifest. Hashing is xxhash (with a quick pre-filter), the keeper is selectable and ``--json``/``--dry-run`` help before acting.

elf64.py.summary: Recursively find the 64-bit ELF binaries of a directory.
details: Parses the ELF headers with pyelftools, prints each 64-bit binary with its type, machine, entry point and section summary and with ``-r`` deletes the matches; ``-L`` follows the symlinks.

erap.py.summary: Run the Python type checkers and either append their output to the sources or write JSON reports.
details: The ``append`` subcommand runs ty, pyright, pylint, pyrefly and mypy on each file and appends the diagnostics as comments, ``report`` writes one JSON report per file under ``report/`` (``-a`` selects all the tools), and the ``dh`` unresolved-import noise is filtered out.

ewhl.py.summary: Move the empty wheels (only ``dist-info``, no code) into a subdirectory.
details: Opens each ``.whl``, checks whether it holds any ``.py`` or ``.so`` member and moves the code-less ones into ``empty_wheels`` (``-d`` renames it), printing each move.

ewhl2.py.summary: Move the empty wheels aside, flagging the ones already installed.
details: Detects the ``.whl`` files without code members, extracts their name and version, checks whether the package is installed (``pip show`` and the import location), prompts before moving and offers ``--auto-move-all`` and ``--no-install-check``.
